verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex documents its own "robust reporting and analytics across payroll and HR data" and a configurable payroll dashboard, which covers payroll reporting at a general level. Nothing in the evidence names payroll registers or gross-to-net reports specifically, or describes exporting reports. Missing for 10: explicit payroll register report, gross-to-net report, export formats (CSV/Excel) for analysis, independent or hands-on corroboration.
